name: Extra Secret of the Pale
body:
Your delve into the secrets of life and death are unceasing, constantly expanding your abilities.

Prerequisite(s): Pale theologian, secrets of the pale class feature

Benefit(s): You gain an additional secret of the pale.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times, allowing you to select a different secret of the pale each time it is selected.
